question:
If ‘+’ means ‘÷’, ‘ ̶ ’ means ‘+’, ‘×’ means ‘−’ and ‘÷’ means ‘×’, what will be the value of the following expression?

[{( 14 × 6 ) - ( 4 ÷ 3 )} + ( 6 - 4 )] ÷ 3
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 6.

Given conditions: ‘+’ means ‘÷’, ‘ ̶ ’ means ‘+’, ‘×’ means ‘−’ and ‘÷’ means ‘×’

Given equation: [{( 14 × 6 ) - ( 4 ÷ 3 )} + ( 6 - 4 )] ÷ 3

After interchanging the expression becomes:

= [{( 14 - 6 ) + ( 4 × 3 )} ÷ ( 6 + 4 )] × 3

= [{8 + 12} ÷ 10] × 3

= [20 ÷ 10] × 3 = 6
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात् 6 है।

दी गई शर्तें: '+' का अर्थ '÷ है', '̶' का अर्थ '+' है, '×' का अर्थ '-' है और '÷' का अर्थ '×' है

दिया गया समीकरण: [{( 14 × 6 ) - (4 ÷ 3 )} + (6 - 4 )] ÷ 3

आपस में बदलने के बाद व्यंजक बन जाता है:

= [{( 14 - 6 ) + ( 4 × 3 )} ÷ ( 6 + 4 )] × 3

= [{8 + 12} ÷ 10] × 3

= [20 ÷ 10] × 3 = 6

question:
If A denotes ‘+’, B denotes ‘×’, C denotes ‘−’, and D denotes ‘÷’, then what will come in place of ‘?’ in the following equation?

2 B ? D 2 = 4 B 32 D 8
solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. 16.

Given conditions: A denotes ‘+’, B denotes ‘×’, C denotes ‘−’, and D denotes ‘÷’

Given equation: 2 B ? D 2 = 4 B 32 D 8

After interchanging the expression becomes:

2 × ? ÷ 2 = 4 × 32 ÷ 8

2 × ? ÷ 2 = 4 × 4

2 × ? ÷ 2 = 16

⇒ ? = 16
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात् 16 है।

दी गई शर्तें: A, '+' को दर्शाता है, B, '×' को दर्शाता है, C, '-' को दर्शाता है, और D, '÷' को दर्शाता है

दिया गया समीकरण: 2 B ? D 2 = 4 B 32 D 8

आपस में बदलने के बाद अभिव्यक्ति बन जाती है:

2 × ? ÷ 2 = 4 × 32 ÷ 8

2 × ? ÷ 2 = 4 × 4

2 × ? ÷ 2 = 16 

⇒ ? = 16

question:
If I denotes ‘÷’, J denotes ‘×’, K denotes ‘−’ and L denotes ‘+’, then what will come in place of ‘?’ in the following equation?

(35 I 5) J 9 K 23 L 39 K (3 J 8) =?
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 55.

Given conditions: I denotes ‘÷’, J denotes ‘×’, K denotes ‘−’ and L denotes ‘+’

Given equation: (35 I 5) J 9 K 23 L 39 K (3 J 8) =?

= (35 ÷ 5) × 9 - 23 + 39 - (3 × 8)

= 7 × 9 - 23 + 39 - 24

= 63 - 23 + 39 - 24 = 55

= (35 ÷ 5) × 9 - 23 + 39 - (3 × 8)

= 7 × 9 - 23 + 39 - 24

= 63 - 23 + 39 - 24 = 55

question:
If ‘+’ means ‘divided by’, ‘ ̶ ’ means ‘added to’, ‘×’ means ‘subtracted from’, and ‘÷’ means ‘multiplied by’, then what will be the value of the following expression?

[{(25 × 13) - (3 ÷ 3)} + (3 - 4)] ÷ 5
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 15.

Given conditions: ‘+’ means ‘divided by’, ‘ ̶ ’ means ‘added to’, ‘×’ means ‘subtracted from’, and ‘÷’ means ‘multiplied by’

Given equation: [{(25 × 13) - (3 ÷ 3)} + (3 - 4)] ÷ 5

After interchanging the expression becomes:

= [{(25 - 13) + (3 × 3)} ÷ (3 + 4)] × 5

= [{12 + 9} ÷ 7] × 5

= [21 ÷ 7] × 5

= 3 × 5 = 15
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात् 15 है।

दी गई शर्तें:  '+' का अर्थ 'विभाजित करना' है, '-' का अर्थ 'जोड़ना' है, '×' का अर्थ 'घटाना' है, और '÷' का अर्थ 'गुणा करना' है

दिया गया समीकरण: [{(25 × 13) - (3 ÷ 3)} + (3 - 4)] ÷ 5

आपस में बदलने के बाद व्यंजक बन जाता है:

= [{(25 - 13) + (3 × 3)} ÷ (3 + 4)] × 5

= [{12 + 9} ÷ 7] × 5

= [21 ÷ 7] × 5

= 3 × 5 = 15
